items.title: Stanford studies find AI benchmarks often fail to measure what they claim
items.summary_en: Stanford researchers and collaborators applied psychometric validity checks to AI benchmarks. Across 56 widely used benchmarks they found many do not reliably measure the concept they are named for, and that benchmarks with the same label can disagree. Per the HAI write-up, the two studies are to be presented in October at the Third Annual Conference on Language Modeling in San Francisco.
